chunks: From him, from Al-Fudayl ibn Abd al-Wahhab, from Is'haq ibn Ubayd Allah, from Ubayd Allah ibn al-Walid al-Wassafi, raising it (to the Prophet), he said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever says "La ilaha illa Allah" (There is no god but Allah), a tree is planted for him in Paradise made of red sapphire, its root in white musk, sweeter than honey, whiter than snow, and more fragrant than musk. In it are fruits like the breasts of virgins, rising above seventy coverings.'
And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The best of worship is the saying "La ilaha illa Allah".'

And he said: 'The best of worship is seeking forgiveness (Istighfar), and this is the word of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, in His Book: "So know that there is no god but Allah, and ask forgiveness for your sin."'

key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: There is no god but Allah (Declaration of Monotheism)

ai.seo_question: What is the best form of worship according to this hadith from Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi underscores the supreme merit of the declaration of Tawhid, promising a specific, luxurious tree in Paradise as a reward for its recitation. It further elevates Istighfar (seeking forgiveness) to the status of the best worship, explicitly linking it to the command in Surah Muhammad to 'know that there is no deity but Allah and seek His forgiveness for your sin.' This connection highlights the Shia scholarly view that cognitive affirmation and verbal repentance are the pillars of spiritual excellence.
